chatDescription: YUBIT official community. Beware of impersonators. Admins will never DM first. Trading content is for information only and is not investment advice.

topics.name: Official Announcements
topics.announcement: YUBIT Official Announcements This topic is for official updates, campaigns, product notices, and risk reminders. YUBIT admins will never ask for passwords, private keys, seed phrases, or remote-control access.

topics.name: Welcome & Rules
topics.announcement: Welcome to YUBIT Please read the rules before chatting: 1. No spam, ads, referral flooding, or impersonation. 2. No private deal solicitation or guaranteed-profit claims. 3. Never trust users pretending to be support in DMs. 4. Trading discussions must include risk awareness. Official bot and AI messages will be clearly labeled.

topics.name: New User Onboarding
topics.announcement: New User Onboarding Use this topic for registration, KYC, deposit, first contract trade, and campaign-task questions. A FAQ bot may answer common questions. Complex issues will be escalated to a human mod.

topics.name: Contract Lab
topics.announcement: Contract Lab Discuss market structure, risk control, position sizing, and trading reviews here. No guaranteed returns. No private paid signals. AI trader content is informational only and not investment advice.

topics.name: Campaign Room
topics.announcement: Campaign Room Campaign tasks, reward rules, leaderboard updates, and claim reminders will be posted here. Final reward eligibility follows the official announcement.

topics.name: VIP Desk
topics.announcement: VIP Desk For VIP service, campaign support, and high-value user escalation. Please do not post sensitive account information publicly.

topics.name: Feedback & Support
topics.announcement: Feedback & Support Report deposit issues, task errors, suspicious users, fake support accounts, or product feedback here. Mods will triage and escalate when needed.

topics.name: AI Traders
topics.announcement: AI Traders Alpha Scout and Beta Hedge may post market observations after safety checks. All AI trader content is informational only and not investment advice. Always manage your own risk.
